tokens.name: w-asphalt
tokens.usage: Roads, car-park floors, tyre rubber on big vehicles. Palette row 0.

tokens.name: w-road-line
tokens.usage: Lane dashes, zebra crossings, parking bays.

tokens.name: w-sidewalk
tokens.usage: Pavement slabs, plaza floor, stoops.

tokens.name: w-kerb
tokens.usage: Kerb edges, steps, planter rims, statue plinths.

tokens.name: w-grass
tokens.usage: Park lawns, verges, roof gardens.

tokens.name: w-soil
tokens.usage: Planter beds, dirt paths, the construction site.

tokens.name: w-water
tokens.usage: Fountain and pond water, swimming pool, canal. Opaque on purpose (mobile overdraw).

tokens.name: w-sand
tokens.usage: Playground pit, beach-volley court, building site.

tokens.name: w-wall-a
tokens.usage: Main facade colour (cream plaster). Most buildings.

tokens.name: w-wall-b
tokens.usage: Second facade (terracotta brick). Alternate every other shop.

tokens.name: w-wall-c
tokens.usage: Third facade (painted blue/green). Corner buildings and kiosks.

tokens.name: w-roof-a
tokens.usage: Pitched roofs, awnings stripe 1. Winter turns it to snow.

tokens.name: w-roof-b
tokens.usage: Flat roofs, bus and truck roofs, dark awnings.

tokens.name: w-glass
tokens.usage: Windows, windscreens, phone screens. Night and Holiday light them warm.

tokens.name: w-trim
tokens.usage: Window frames, door frames, cornices, sign borders.

tokens.name: w-door
tokens.usage: Doors, shutters, bench slats on dark props.

tokens.name: w-metal
tokens.usage: Poles, railings, rims, vending machine body, cans.

tokens.name: w-metal-dark
tokens.usage: Lamp posts, bin bodies, machinery, scaffolding.

tokens.name: w-rubber
tokens.usage: Tyres, skateboard grip, cables, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: w-wood
tokens.usage: Benches, crates, pallets, market stalls, guitar body.

tokens.name: w-leaf
tokens.usage: Tree canopy (light face), hedges, potted plants.

tokens.name: w-leaf-dark
tokens.usage: Tree canopy (shadow face), topiary, ivy.

tokens.name: w-bark
tokens.usage: Trunks, wooden poles, cardboard.

tokens.name: w-white
tokens.usage: Pure highlights: sneakers, fridge, ice cream, porcelain, road signs.

tokens.name: w-accent-red
tokens.usage: Hero accent 1: fire hydrant, buses, taxis' trim, the giant tube man.

tokens.name: w-accent-yellow
tokens.usage: Hero accent 2: taxi body, traffic cone band, crane, rubber duck.

tokens.name: w-accent-blue
tokens.usage: Hero accent 3: e-scooters, mailboxes, utility vans, recycling bins.

tokens.name: w-accent-pink
tokens.usage: Hero accent 4: donut icing, flamingo, food-truck wraps.

tokens.name: w-accent-orange
tokens.usage: Hero accent 5: traffic cones, construction kit, basketballs.

tokens.name: w-accent-teal
tokens.usage: Hero accent 6: arcade cabinets, gaming chairs, shop signs.

tokens.name: w-glow
tokens.usage: Light faces: lamp heads, neon signs, headlights. Use with Material Neon, never a PointLight per prop.

tokens.name: w-season
tokens.usage: The seasonal overlay face: snow caps, blossom, leaf piles, neon strips. Model caps and piles on every roof, hedge and car roof with this swatch.

tokens.name: light-sky
tokens.usage: Lighting: Sky top colour (Atmosphere.Color / skybox tint).

tokens.name: light-fog
tokens.usage: Lighting: FogColor and Atmosphere.Decay. Hides streaming edges.

tokens.name: light-ambient
tokens.usage: Lighting: OutdoorAmbient.

tokens.name: ui-panel
tokens.usage: Panels: Results, TopBar, Settings (UiKit PANEL_COLOUR 40,44,52). Ground for ui-text.

tokens.name: ui-card
tokens.usage: Book cards and shop tiles on ui-panel (BookUi CARD_COLOUR 58,63,74). Ground for ui-text.

tokens.name: ui-button
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and selected options (UiKit BUTTON_COLOUR 60,140,90). ui-text on it is 4.1:1, passes only because button text is 28px with the 2px ui-stroke outline; never put text under 24px on it.

tokens.name: ui-off
tokens.usage: Off toggles and unselected options (OFF_COLOUR 90,94,102). ui-text on it 6.5:1.

tokens.name: ui-track
tokens.usage: Slider tracks (TRACK_COLOUR 20,22,26).

tokens.name: ui-handle
tokens.usage: Slider handles on ui-track.

tokens.name: ui-text
tokens.usage: All UI text, always with the ui-stroke outline. Reads on ui-panel, ui-card, ui-off, ui-control and over the 3D world.

tokens.name: ui-stroke
tokens.usage: 2px UIStroke on every text element (STROKE_COLOUR 20,20,20).

tokens.name: ui-control
tokens.usage: Touch controls: Jump button and thumbstick base (60,60,60), at 0.3–0.5 transparency over the world.

tokens.name: ui-unknown
tokens.usage: Silhouette fill for book entries not found yet (UNKNOWN_COLOUR).

tokens.name: ui-bar-back
tokens.usage: Size meter bar background (Hud 30,30,30).

tokens.name: ui-bar-fill
tokens.usage: Size meter progress fill (Hud 110,200,120); 8.9:1 on ui-bar-back.

tokens.name: ui-highlight
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: selected shop tile ring, coin glyph, new-item dot. 9.8:1 on ui-panel. Never a button fill.

tokens.name: tier-1
tokens.usage: Tier 1 chip and stand-in part colour (ObjectVisual TIER_COLOURS[1]). Always beside the tier number.

tokens.name: tier-2
tokens.usage: Tier 2 chip and stand-in colour.

tokens.name: tier-3
tokens.usage: Tier 3 chip and stand-in colour.

tokens.name: tier-4
tokens.usage: Tier 4 chip and stand-in colour.

tokens.name: tier-5
tokens.usage: Tier 5 chip and stand-in colour.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Results title and stars (ResultsUi TITLE_SIZE). Enum.Font.FredokaOne.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: Tier banner, timer, all button labels (BANNER/TIMER/BUTTON_TEXT_SIZE). Caps for banners.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Results rows, book progress, pickup pop (BODY_SIZE). Enum.Font.GothamMedium.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Tips, notices, shop 'what it does' line. 18px is the floor (Config.minTextSize); nothing smaller on any screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: HUD edge margin (Hud METER_MARGIN, TIMER_TOP).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and columns (ResultsUi BUTTON_GAP, COLUMN_MARGIN).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Jump button inset from the bottom-right corner.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons and toggles (UiKit CornerRadius 12).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and shop tiles (PANEL_CORNER).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Slider track and handle, Jump button, ball previews (UDim 0.5).

tokens.name: touch-main
tokens.usage: Jump, Merge, Roll again: Config.minTouchTarget.

tokens.name: touch-utility
tokens.usage: TopBar icon buttons and close: Config.minUtilityTouchTarget.

tokens.name: stroke-text
tokens.usage: UIStroke thickness on all text.
